essence: The idea shown as it is, precisely. Thin exact strokes on a dark field where a concept is built from its parts and each step is visible.
explains_by: Build from the parts: start with the simplest case and add one thing at a time.
The picture is the proof: the shape or graph shows why it is true.
One colour for the thing being followed; everything else stays cool.

techniques.name: construct step by step
techniques.how: a Manim clip or drawn strokes building in order

techniques.name: morph between forms
techniques.use: the same idea seen two ways

vocabulary: one warm yellow for the followed thing
